eindtekst: Preview checks columns and detected types before ingest: override a type, click Next, and Query turns your choices into the SQL that lands the table.

stappen.tekst: Preview always starts from a candidate source. Here we use the Remote tab: it ingests straight from a URL, no manual download.
Open the Remote tab to reach the URL flow.
Type the direct link to a CSV, Parquet or JSON file. Load copies it into the workspace and hands it to Preview.
Load downloads the file and routes to Preview for a column and type check before anything is written.
The meta bar sums up the candidate: name regions, CSV, field and row counts, and file size. Preview itself is read-only, nothing lands in DuckDB yet.
Every column shows its detected type with a dropdown to override it, an editable name, and an on/off switch to drop a column. Here quantity was switched from BIGINT to DOUBLE.
Next commits your choices: it generates the SQL that reads the file with your casts, renames and column filters.
stappen.klaar: Generated SQL and moved to Query.

stappen.tekst: You land in Query, not Data: the editor holds the generated SELECT with CAST(quantity AS DOUBLE), already run so the result grid confirms the data reads cleanly.
Ingest opens the final step: name the table, add tags, and confirm to materialize this SELECT into the workspace DuckDB.
The table name is prefilled from the source file. Confirm here and the table shows up under Data, ready to query.
